description: This file declares external functions for interacting with the RTL8367C switch ASIC, specifically for miscellaneous operations such as setting and getting MAC addresses, debug info, port jam mode, and maximum length configurations.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicMacAddress
methods.description: Sets the MAC address of the ASIC.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicMacAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the ASIC.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicDebugInfo
methods.description: Gets debugging information for a specific port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicPortJamMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current port jam mode configuration.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicMaxLengthCfg
methods.description: Sets the maximum length configuration for a specific configuration ID.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicMaxLengthCfg
methods.description: Gets the maximum length configuration for a specific configuration ID.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicMaxLength
methods.description: Configures the maximum length for a specific port and type, using a configuration ID.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicMaxLength
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum length settings for a port and type.
